thread:
rachel: Spun up a tiny canary for tide-ptq-int6 on onboard toolcall traffic. Noticed a repeat class where array-valued params get fragmented across the final chunks, leading to parse errors in downstream tool parsers.

pavel: Example from trace:
```
{"tool":"bulk_update","items":[{"id":1,"state":"ok"}, {"id":2,"state":"fail"},
...<stream cut>
}
```
Parser: unexpected EOF in array (expected ']')

emily: Interesting — float and int8 show this rarely. tide-int6 streaming shows higher rate for larger arrays (>5 items). Non-streaming replay OK.

oz: Could be chunk boundary insertion or replica mirror mismatch where a trailing chunk from replica-B gets dropped on switch. We saw similar behavior when mirror replicas had out-of-sync tail flush.

rachel: Any infra evictions in the same window? If a worker switch happens mid-stream we might lose final chunk.

pavel: Checking now — slight spike in replica-handovers and a few container restarts aligning with failures.

telemetry-bot: canary-deploy tide-ptq-int6 -> 2026-04-12T08:12:30Z (id: d4e6f)

emily: Short-term proposals: (1) enable a downstream-safe "array-complete" heuristic in the client that, on parse-fail and output looks like an open array, attempts to append "]" and retry once; (2) instrument mirror_mismatch_rate and final_chunk_presence_ratio; (3) flip 15% of canary to sync-mode to validate streaming-only.

oz: +1. Also capture masked last-16 tokens for failures to check whether we see partial object or partial token fragments — helps determine kernel vs streamer loss.

rachel: I prefer minimal masking and explicit logging for canary only. Also add a "repair_shim" metric so we don't hide regressions. If repair_shim_rate > 0.5% vs baseline we auto-alert.

pavel: I'll wire metrics: array_fragment_count, repair_shim_count, mirror_mismatch_rate, last_chunk_latency_ms. Dashboard ETA 25m.

emily: For retries: allow one internal retry for canary when parse-fail and length > 80 tokens; retry forces sync-mode and doesn't burn user retry quota. Log repair_retry_win.

oz: If sync-mode removes the frag class that's strong signal for streamer/mirror race. Then fix is either stronger final-chunk persist on handover, or ensure mirror tail flush is acknowledged before handoff.

rachel: Plan: 1) enable sync-probe 15% (pavel doing), 2) enable client array-complete shim for canary, 3) capture masked suffix, 4) run 5k-prompt replay across float/int8/int6 for 2h and compare structured-output pass + fragment class distribution.

pavel: Sync-probe flipped. Starting harness now. Will post diffs in ~2h.

emily: Thanks — keep canary tight and visible. If anyone sees repair_shim masking >1% we rollback and repopulate trace capture. :eyes:

rachel: tagging infra to watch replica handovers during this window. Good catch team.
